line: Tuesday has extra spark for you. Wear the bright shirt to work.
Your ideas come out well today. Share one in the meeting, not after it.
Your people are fired up today. Team up on the big task; finish by six.
Someone shines loudly today. Let them; your steady glow lasts longer.
A wise thought arrives today. Sit with it over lunch before you decide.
Warm help reaches you today. Say yes when someone offers to check your work.
The heat is on today. Start the hardest task at nine, not at four.
Your polish gets noticed today. Present the final version; skip the apologies.
A big chance rises today. Put your hand up first, then plan.
Steady money wins today. Book the year-end trip at the early-bird price.
